mapper.sql: select id, cTime, projectCode, projectName, projectTypeName, customerName, branchOrgName, contractNo, contractAmount, contractFinalAmount, year from sys_bc_gcbb
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_bc_gcbb
cTime, projectCode, projectName, projectTypeName, customerName, branchOrgName, contractNo, contractAmount, contractFinalAmount, year,
#{cTime}, #{projectCode}, #{projectName}, #{projectTypeName}, #{customerName}, #{branchOrgName}, #{contractNo}, #{contractAmount}, #{contractFinalAmount}, #{year},
mapper.delete:
delete from sys_bc_gcbb where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT branchOrgName, -- ① 所有总数 COUNT(*) AS totalCount, -- ② 本周数 SUM( CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE( cTime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL WEEKDAY( CURRENT_DATE ) DAY, '%Y-%m-%d' ), ' 00:00:00' ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL WEEKDAY( CURRENT_DATE ) DAY + 6, '%Y-%m-%d' ), ' 23:59:59' ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS weekCount, -- ③ 含售 SUM( CASE WHEN projectCode LIKE '%售%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS sellYearCount, SUM( CASE WHEN projectCode LIKE '%售%' AND STR_TO_DATE( cTime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL WEEKDAY( CURRENT_DATE ) DAY, '%Y-%m-%d' ), ' 00:00:00' ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL WEEKDAY( CURRENT_DATE ) DAY + 6, '%Y-%m-%d' ), ' 23:59:59' ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS sellWeekCount, -- ④ 含规 SUM( CASE WHEN projectCode LIKE '%规%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS planYearCount, SUM( CASE WHEN projectCode LIKE '%规%' AND STR_TO_DATE( cTime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL WEEKDAY( CURRENT_DATE ) DAY, '%Y-%m-%d' ), ' 00:00:00' ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL WEEKDAY( CURRENT_DATE ) DAY + 6, '%Y-%m-%d' ), ' 23:59:59' ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS planWeekCount, -- ⑤ 含管按类型 SUM( CASE WHEN projectCode LIKE '%管%' AND LOWER( projectTypeName ) LIKE '%cctv%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS pipeCctvCount,-- 含“管” 且 projectTypeName 中不包含 'cctv'（不区分大小写） SUM( CASE WHEN projectCode LIKE '%管%' AND ( projectTypeName IS NULL OR LOWER( projectTypeName ) NOT LIKE '%cctv%' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS pipeOtherCount, -- ⑥ 含政按类型分 SUM( CASE WHEN projectCode LIKE '%政%' AND ( projectTypeName LIKE '%土方%' OR projectTypeName LIKE '%控制%' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS govYearEarthControlCount, SUM( CASE WHEN projectCode LIKE '%政%' AND ( projectTypeName NOT LIKE '%土方%' AND projectTypeName NOT LIKE '%控制%' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS govYearRoadCount, SUM( CASE WHEN projectCode LIKE '%政%' AND STR_TO_DATE( cTime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL WEEKDAY( CURRENT_DATE ) DAY, '%Y-%m-%d' ), ' 00:00:00' ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL WEEKDAY( CURRENT_DATE ) DAY + 6, '%Y-%m-%d' ), ' 23:59:59' ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AND ( projectTypeName LIKE '%土方%' OR projectTypeName LIKE '%控制%' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS govWeekEarthControlCount, SUM( CASE WHEN projectCode LIKE '%政%' AND STR_TO_DATE( cTime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL WEEKDAY( CURRENT_DATE ) DAY, '%Y-%m-%d' ), ' 00:00:00' ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL WEEKDAY( CURRENT_DATE ) DAY + 6, '%Y-%m-%d' ), ' 23:59:59' ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AND ( projectTypeName NOT LIKE '%土方%' AND projectTypeName NOT LIKE '%控制%' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS govWeekRoadCount, -- ⑦ 含籍 SUM( CASE WHEN projectCode LIKE '%籍%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS jiCount FROM sys_bc_gcbb WHERE branchOrgName IS NOT NULL AND year = #{year} GROUP BY branchOrgName;
